metadata.reference: k_eff, log[:,26]; contact from normal force and tissue gain
metadata.cases: corrected_comparison.cases(); observations recorded once per source; every method sees identical rows and no truth
metadata.segments: plateau, transition: no scene event; rate of ln k_eff (0.2 s boxcar) below .05/s away from transitions, above .2/s; between them unassigned. event: every tick in [start, end+.3]; event_only and event_transition split it by whether the reference is also changing.
metadata.channels: raw: window output, last valid held. k_good: after that method's gates, consumed by the feed-forward; gates-on hosts apply CENTRE 1.054. Memory methods: raw is the filter output.
metadata.rates: valid: raw finite and positive; accepted: precise and consistent per host gates; usable: both; false_update: |ln(k/k_eff)|>ln1.2 among accepted ticks; low_update: its low side; coverage: |err|<=2 sigma among accepted ticks. Xue sigma is a fixed interface addition, not an uncertainty.
metadata.tracking: Transitions by family. no_event: all scenes, |d ln k|>=.3, not overlapping an event. core_scenes: its A, A_slow_thin, A+B part. no_event_small: .15<=|d ln k|<.3. event_coupled: all scenes, |d ln k|>=.3, overlapping an event. Events after contact loss are kept and flagged. Lag on pre-transition-debiased error; under_raw and recovery on raw error; recovery: within ln1.2 for .2 s, capped at 2 s, otherwise unrecovered.
metadata.limits: Open-loop replay: an estimator does not influence the trajectory it sees. Configurations frozen, selected before the H correction. Six cases per scene, descriptive only. Timings are Python prototype under parallel workers, not real-time evidence.
